# webhook-handler
> Secure webhook receiver with HMAC-SHA256 verification and idempotency

Secure webhook receiver with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, idempotency via request ID caching, and timestamp tolerance to prevent replay attacks.

## API
- `WebhookEvent`
- `WebhookHandler`

## Install
Each library is a standalone GitHub repo under github.com/FerrowAI.

Part of the Ferrow open-source toolkit: https://github.com/FerrowAI/ferrow-toolkit — sponsored by https://ferrow.ai
